title: Kate and the Lake
skill_description: Practice reading long vowel words with the magic e pattern: a_e (cake, lake), i_e (bike, time), o_e (home, note), u_e (cube, cute).
author: FunBookies
summary: Kate goes to the lake where she finds a cute mule named Duke. They ride bikes, make a cake, and Kate hopes to bring Duke home.

pages.scene: A smiling girl named Kate standing by a sparkling blue lake with a friendly mule nearby. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Kate woke up in June. She said, "I hope to ride my bike!"
pages.scene: A girl waking up happily in her bedroom on a sunny June morning. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Kate rode her bike to the lake. The ride was five miles.
pages.scene: A girl riding a blue bike along a path toward a lake. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Kate came to the lake. She said, "I like this lake! It is so fine!"
pages.scene: A girl arriving at a beautiful blue lake, bike beside her. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Kate sat on a big stone by the lake. She gave a wave.
pages.scene: A girl sitting on a large stone by the water, waving. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: A cute mule came to Kate. His name was Duke.
pages.scene: A friendly tan mule approaching a girl by the lake. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: "Duke! You are so cute!" said Kate. Duke was huge but safe.
pages.scene: Kate petting the large but gentle mule named Duke. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Kate and Duke made a game. They hid by the lake and the pine.
pages.scene: Kate and Duke playing hide and seek near pine trees by the lake. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Kate rode on Duke. What a fine ride! Duke was safe to ride.
pages.scene: Kate riding on Duke the mule along the lakeshore. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Kate said, "Duke, I hope you like cake. I will bake one at home!"
pages.scene: Kate talking to Duke, gesturing about making a cake. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Kate rode her bike home. She made a cake. The cake was huge!
pages.scene: Kate in her kitchen baking a large cake. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Kate rode back to the lake. She gave Duke the cake. Duke ate it!
pages.scene: Kate giving Duke a piece of cake by the lake. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Duke gave Kate a rose. Kate said, "I like this rose! It is so fine!"
pages.scene: Duke offering a rose to Kate with his mouth. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Kate wrote a note: "I hope to see Duke at the lake each time."
pages.scene: Kate writing a note with Duke watching. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Kate woke the next day. She rode her bike to the same lake.
pages.scene: Kate riding toward the lake eagerly the next morning. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Duke came to Kate! Kate said, "We are the same. We like the lake!"
pages.scene: Duke running to greet Kate at the lake. Warm watercolor style.

pages.text: Kate and Duke sat by the lake. It was a fine time and a safe place.
pages.scene: Kate and Duke sitting peacefully by the lake at sunset. Warm watercolor style.
Kate hugging Duke by the lake with a beautiful sunset. Warm watercolor style.

parent_tips.before_reading: Preview 'Kate and the Lake' together. Ask: What do you think Kate will do? Look for short vowel words like: Kate, lake, make, cake, take.
parent_tips.during_reading: Help your child sound out tricky words. Notice the short vowel pattern in words like Kate, lake, make, cake, take. Encourage expression when reading!
parent_tips.after_reading: Discuss: What happened when Kate got into trouble? What happened at the end? What was your favorite part about the home?
